title: Characterization of zero-error randomized polynomial time
statement: For every language $L$ of Boolean strings, $L$ belongs to zero-error randomized polynomial time if and only if it belongs to both randomized polynomial time and co-randomized polynomial time, with all three classes defined using the polynomial-time verifier model.
